issue_context.title: Wemo Integration Doesn't Retry Static Connections, Rarely Gets All of Them on First Try
issue_context.body:
### The problem

When static device IPs are used in the Wemo integration, Home Assistant tries exactly once to connect to each defined static device, then marks it broken and ignores it forever. Since connections to wemo devices are notoriously flaky, the usual remedy is to just repeatedly restart Home Assistant until users get lucky and everything is successful at the same time. Also users troubleshooting networks settings must restart Home Assistant after every change to network settings. Even when network settings are correct (i.e. http://<wemo ip>:4915x/setup.xml responds to browser requests), often not all static devices are added.

A better approach would be to check static devices during Discovery and use the same add_unique_device logic that's used for dynamically discovered devices.

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.3.2

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

Wemo

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/wemo
